subject: Hayes Model 21 in lavaan: how to implement second stage interaction

messages.author: 87a06509cf3df601
messages.subject: Hayes Model 21 in lavaan: how to implement second stage interaction
parts:
Hi there

I am currently looking for a way to implement hayes Model 21 (see picture, from http://www.personal.psu.edu/jxb14/M554/specreg/templates.pdf), a moderated mediation with 2 moderators.
How can I implement the second stage interaction of the mediator with the moderator? Is there a way to create the Interaction within the model? Right now I am creating the interaction beforehand in the dataframe, which is ok for the first-stage interaction, as it comes directly from the data - but for the second stage (correct me if I am wrong), I would need to draw on the regressed mediator?!

Thank you so much in advance!

My code looks like this (X and Y are 0/1, the rest is continuous; XW is X*W in the dataframe; MV is M*V in the dataframe):

modmedmod2<- ' # regressions
M ~ a1*X+control1+control2+control3
Y ~ b1*M
Y ~ b2*V
Y ~ b3*MV
M ~ a2*W
M ~ a3*XW
Y ~ cdash*X+control4+control5

# mean of  W (for use in simple slopes)
W ~ W.mean*1
V ~ V.mean*1

# variance of moderators (for use in simple slopes)
W ~~ W.var*W
V ~~ V.var*V

# indirect effects conditional on moderators
indirect.WLVL := a1*b1 + a3*b1*(W.mean-sqrt(W.var))+a1*b3*(V.mean-sqrt(V.var))+a3*b3*(W.mean-sqrt(W.var))*(V.mean-sqrt(V.var))
indirect.WLVM := a1*b1 + a3*b1*(W.mean-sqrt(W.var))+a1*b3*V.mean+a3*(W.mean-sqrt(W.var))*b3*V.mean
indirect.WLVH := a1*b1 + a3*b1*(W.mean-sqrt(W.var))+a1*b3*(V.mean+sqrt(V.var))+a3*(W.mean-sqrt(W.var))*b3*(V.mean+sqrt(V.var))

indirect.WMVL := a1*b1 + a3*W.mean*b1+a1*b3*(V.mean-sqrt(V.var))+a3*W.mean*b3*(V.mean-sqrt(V.var))
indirect.WMVM := a1*b1 + a3*W.mean*b1+a1*b3*V.mean+a3*W.mean*b3*V.mean
indirect.WMVH := a1*b1 + a3*W.mean*b1+a1*b3*(V.mean+sqrt(V.var))+a3*W.mean*b3*(V.mean+sqrt(V.var))

indirect.WHVL := a1*b1 + a3*(W.mean+sqrt(W.var))*b1+a1*b3*(V.mean-sqrt(V.var))+a3*(W.mean+sqrt(W.var))*b3*(V.mean-sqrt(V.var))
indirect.WHVM := a1*b1 + a3*(W.mean+sqrt(W.var))*b1+a1*b3*V.mean+a3*(W.mean+sqrt(W.var))*b3*V.mean
indirect.WHVH := a1*b1 + a3*(W.mean+sqrt(W.var))*b1+a1*b3*(V.mean+sqrt(V.var))+a3*(W.mean+sqrt(W.var))*b3*(V.mean+sqrt(V.var))'

messages.author: bfa43814f6ba1969
messages.subject: Re: Hayes Model 21 in lavaan: how to implement second stage interaction
parts:
Hi,

M and V are both observed, so M*V is calculated from raw data. I am not sure why you think M would be calculated from the first regression. 

Consider their Model 4: if the second stage would be calculated based on fitted M, that fitted value would be perfectly collinear with X and estimating the regression would be impossible.

Mikko
